decision: The public release is sufficient to reproduce all four frequency baselines and to reimplement model training, but it does not provide a fully archived, authentication-free model run bundle that fixes all four final checkpoints, predictions, and run identities. Training a fresh model from inferred defaults would be a new run, not verification of the exact published artifacts.
v1_boundary: Product v1.0.0 stabilizes the audit software, data identities, four baseline reproductions, split audit, and prespecified similarity/provenance evidence. It does not relabel the four published neural-model cells as independently reproduced.
